title: Viatris Announces Quarterly Dividend
body_markdown:
PITTSBURGH


, Nov. 4, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[Viatris Inc.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813563-1&h=3391667857&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.viatris.com%2F&a=Viatris+Inc.) (Nasdaq: VTRS), a global healthcare company, today announced that on November 2, 2026, its Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $0.12 per share for each issued and outstanding share of the Company's common stock. The dividend is payable on December 16, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 23, 2026.


As previously announced, Viatris will report third-quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, November 5, 2026. Company executives will host a conference call and live webcast at 8:30 a.m. ET on the same date to discuss Viatris' third-quarter 2026 financial results and the planned acquisition of Pacira BioSciences. Investors and the general public are invited to listen to a live webcast of the call at[investor.viatris.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813563-1&h=2792437979&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4788659-1%26h%3D4047322559%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Finvestor.viatris.com%252F%26a%3Dinvestor.viatris.com&a=investor.viatris.com) or by calling 844.308.3344 or 412.317.1896 for international callers. A replay of the webcast also will be available on the website.


**About Viatris**[Viatris Inc](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813563-1&h=4202318960&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.viatris.com%2F&a=Viatris+Inc) . (Nasdaq: VTRS) is a global healthcare company whose mission is to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life. We meet the needs of patients around the world by acting decisively with ingenuity and resolve. Whether we're developing new medicines, working to maintain a resilient supply of needed therapies, or pursuing bold innovation, we strive to deliver solutions that are effective at scale and built to endure. We're purpose-built to make an impact with a broad portfolio that spans generics, value-added medicines, established brands, and innovative medicines that address areas of significant unmet need. We are headquartered in the U.S., with global centers in Pittsburgh, Shanghai and Hyderabad, India. Learn more at[viatris.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813563-1&h=3267365393&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.viatris.com%2F&a=viatris.com) and[investor.viatris.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813563-1&h=1852215485&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.viatris.com%2F&a=investor.viatris.com) , and connect with us on[LinkedIn](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813563-1&h=1036034611&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fviatris%2Fmycompany%2Fverification%2F&a=LinkedIn) ,[Instagram](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813563-1&h=3501718941&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fviatrisinc&a=Instagram) ,[YouTube](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813563-1&h=184442797&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fviatris&a=YouTube) and[X](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4813563-1&h=1476057909&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2FViatrisInc&a=X) .
